공통: One continuous shot, no cuts. The camera is locked off exactly as in the start frame: no zoom, no pan, no tilt, no shake. Keep the exact handmade needle-felt miniature look of the start frame in every frame: fine wool felt fibres, visible stitches, matte felt and wool; every object keeps its shape, size and colour and never turns into a realistic thing. MONGLE is the coral-pink felt blob. At rest its face is only its two glossy black bead eyes: no nose and no mouth. When its feeling changes, its whole face changes to show that feeling, as written in ACTION, always in needle-felt: the eyes may grow bigger and rounder, squeeze shut into short curved dark stitched lines, curve into happy arcs or droop under little felt lids; a small simple felt mouth may open, smile, pout or wobble; blush, a felt sweat drop or a felt teardrop may appear. When the feeling passes, the mouth and the drops go away and the face returns to rest. Open eyes always stay glossy black beads: no white sclera, no coloured iris, no sparkling cartoon eyes, no eyelashes, no human teeth or lips. Mongle has NO arms, NO legs, NO hands and NO neck, ever: no limbs ever grow, nothing ever sticks out of its body. It moves only by tilting, squashing, stretching and bouncing its whole soft dome body. LOOK: the same light and colours as the start frame, unchanged to the last frame. Apart from Mongle's own expression, nothing new appears that is not in the start frame. If MONGLE is not in the start frame it never comes in. MONGLE does not blink. No speed lines, no motion lines, no cartoon effects, no steam, no smoke. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos. No sound.

ACTION: From 0 to 1.0 s the owner sets the plate of golden felt dumplings down on the back half of the table and lets go. From 1.0 to 2.0 s he straightens up a little with a big proud warm grin, his left hand dropping to his side while he moves his RIGHT felt hand down and forward and lays it flat, palm down, on the front of the table just left of the wallet, exactly as in the end frame; it rests there until the end. From 1.0 to 2.0 s Mongle's bead eyes follow the plate. At about 2.2 s Mongle only tilts its dome a little toward the owner and looks up at him, puzzled, eyes a little rounder. Mongle stays sitting flat on the table the whole time: its scalloped hem always rests on the table top, it never stands up and nothing grows under it. The wallet, the bowl and the chopsticks never move.

The plate and the dumplings never move.

클립.prompt: Medium shot of the owner across the table from the start frame, Mongle at the right edge. ACTION: From 0 to 1.2 s the owner lowers the white felt plate of sweet-and-sour pork the last finger's width and sets it down on the table next to the dumplings. From 1.2 to 2.4 s he straightens up, beaming proudly, and gives one small proud nod. From 2.4 to 4.0 s he opens one hand toward the new plate, palm up, smiling at Mongle. At 1.0 s Mongle leans back a little more in surprise, then stays leaning back. The wallet stays flat where it is; nothing moves unless a hand touches it.

Very close on Mongle from the start frame, the open yellow felt wallet and a few gold felt coins on the table on the left. ACTION: From 0 to 1.0 s Mongle's bead eyes dart left, then right, its two pale-blue felt sweat beads staying on its side. From 1.0 to 2.2 s Mongle squashes forward and nudges the open wallet with the front of its scalloped hem, and three more small gold felt coins slide out of the wallet along the table to the left; the coins slide flat on the table and never fly. From 2.2 to 3.0 s Mongle settles back, its small wavy felt mouth wobbling.

Wide high view of the whole crowded table from the start frame. ACTION: From 0 to 1.5 s the owner lowers the big white felt bowl of red jjamppong with both hands the last bit onto the last free spot of the table. From 1.5 to 2.5 s he lets go and steps back half a step with both hands open, beaming at the full table. From 2.5 to 4.0 s small Mongle between the bowls slowly sinks lower, squashing down, its bead eyes getting wider. No dish moves unless the owner's hands touch it.

Very close on Mongle from the start frame, eyes squeezed shut, the small heap of gold felt coins and the empty open wallet in front of it. ACTION: From 0 to 2.2 s Mongle squashes forward with its whole body and shoves the heap of gold felt coins and the wallet to the left in three short pushes; the coins slide along the table and never fly up. Mongle's eyes stay squeezed shut into two short felt arcs and its small open felt mouth stays in a panicked 'O'. From 2.2 to 3.0 s Mongle stays squashed forward, breathing hard, its body rising and falling a little.

Medium close on the owner from the start frame, Mongle at the right edge. ACTION: From 0 to 1.2 s the owner bursts into a warm laugh, shoulders bouncing, eyes squeezed into happy curves. From 1.2 to 3.0 s his raised right hand waves palm-out in a friendly 'no, no' twice while his left hand slowly sweeps the heap of gold felt coins and the yellow wallet back across the table toward Mongle on the right. From 3.0 to 4.0 s he smiles and nods once at Mongle. Mongle looks up at him with round bead eyes and tilts its dome a little at 2.0 s.

Close on Mongle from the start frame with its sparkling felt star eyes. ACTION: From 0 to 1.5 s Mongle lets out a long relieved breath: its dome slowly flattens and widens a little, its rosy cheeks glowing, its small happy open felt mouth widening. From 1.5 to 3.0 s it gives one small happy bounce and settles. The closed yellow wallet and the coins in front of it do not move.

Medium shot from the start frame: Mongle with one empty white felt plate balanced on its head, empty felt bowls on the table, the owner at the left edge. ACTION: From 0 to 1.5 s Mongle stretches tall and tilts the plate on its head toward the owner on the left, offering it, its happy curved eyes and cheeky smile staying. From 1.5 to 3.0 s it bounces twice, small and happy; the plate stays balanced on its head the whole time and never falls. From 3.0 to 4.0 s it holds the plate tilted toward the owner. The owner keeps smiling and looks at Mongle, his hands resting on the table.

Very close on the owner from the start frame, holding a small plain cream felt paper slip. ACTION: From 0 to 0.8 s his smile goes stiff and frozen, and he blinks once slowly; the felt sweat bead stays at his temple. From 0.8 to 2.2 s his right hand slides the small cream paper slip forward toward the camera. From 2.2 to 3.0 s he holds it there with an awkward fixed grin, eyebrows a little raised.

Close on Mongle from the start frame: pale Mongle with an empty white felt plate on its head, the small cream paper slip and the yellow wallet on the table in front of it. ACTION: From 0 to 0.6 s Mongle's bead eyes grow a little bigger. From 0.6 to 1.8 s the empty plate on its head slowly slides a little to one side and stops, still on its head. From 1.8 to 3.0 s Mongle's colour turns a shade paler and one small pale-blue felt sweat bead appears on its side; its tiny straight felt mouth stays.
